name: WFIGS_Daily_Perimeters_Public
title: WFIGS Daily Perimeters
description:
This data set is part of an ongoing project to produce progression-related data automatically for wildland fire incidents. Interim data edits, mistakes, or other issues will be preserved by this process. It is not and should not be treated as an official progression.
 
It is already a large, complex data set that may take some time to load. A default visible scale range is set so that data will not display until the map is zoomed to approximately the ‘State’ level.
 
 
The Wildland Fire Interagency Geospatial Services (WFIGS) Group provides authoritative geospatial data products under the interagency Wildland Fire Data Program. Hosted in the National Interagency Fire Center ArcGIS Online Organization (The NIFC Org), WFIGS provides both internal and public facing data, accessible in a variety of formats. 
  • This service includes all captured geometry changes from the WFIGS Interagency Fire Perimeters.
  • Attribute-only changes are written to the most recent feature. Geometry changes are written as a new feature.
  • A 'Burn Period' is automatically applied to each new feature, giving a sequential order to the perimeter changes.
    This is not a regular or equal measurement of time, only a way to order the changes.


Perimeters are not available for every incident.

Data are refreshed every 5 minutes. Changes in the perimeter source may take up to 15 minutes to display.
WFIGS Perimeters are pulled from multiple sources with rules in place to ensure the most current or most authoritative shape is used.
